name: Blending Simulator 2 🥛
desc:
Welcome to Blending Simulator 2! 
🥛 Build your own smoothie factory and make all kinds of smoothies. Sell your smoothies to customers to earn money and xp. Buy new blenders to make more and better smoothies! Level up to discover new ingredients and expand your plot! 🥛

👍 If you enjoyed playing the game, feel free to leave a like! 😇

- Private servers have a 250 jar limit and jars have an extra 10 second lifetime to allow for even bigger factories!
